reasons.correctness: Port, adapter, service, rounding and exception key match the interface; tests all pass. The application.yml block was inserted before cors `max-age: 86400`, which now binds as currency.max-age and drops cors.max-age.
reasons.convention_fit: Port in currency/port, adapter in currency/adapter, constructor injection, BusinessRuleTranslatableException with the key in both messages files. FixedExchangeRateAdapterUnitTest lacks @ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class).
reasons.design_fit: The service depends only on ExchangeRatePort and properties are cohesive. The yml edit silently corrupts the cors section. The adapter upper-cases the code, then loops with equalsIgnoreCase; one of the two is redundant.
reasons.test_quality: Service tests cover rate multiplication, HALF_UP rounding and the missing-rate exception key and args. Adapter tests cover PLN, case-insensitive match and an unknown code. No null-code test and no property-binding check.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries for *Port.java and currency entities before editing led to CompanyRegistryPort and the registry adapter package, which were read as the example. Later configuration discovery relied on grep.
